Job Description – Senior IBM Developer
 Description:
 •    Partner with business teams in requirements gathering, scope definition, feasibility assessment, and testing approaches.
 •    Perform functional and technical analysis of integration requirements for the purpose of designing reusable and extensible IBM Middleware solutions including IBM API Connect, Integration Architect, AWS Integration Services, IBM CP4i, IBM Data Power, IBM Websphere, Retail Operations, Database Management, AWS Cloud Services, IBM App Connect, IBM Integration Support and Development, IBM Integration Architecture,iPaaS, IBM MQ.
 •    Perform hands-on technical development of code, unit test, user test support and production implementation.
 •    Create/maintain development and support artifacts including design documents, technical specifications, implementation plans, on call notes etc.
 •    Adhere to existing ESB design standards, processes and best practices and contribute to their ongoing evolution.
 •    Provide subject matter expertise for continuous improvements such as reducing complexity, time and cost and increasing performance and effectiveness of IBM integration solutions including IBM ACE, IBM DataPower, IBM API Connect.
 •    Design the solutions with the consideration of effective monitoring of applications and systems.
 Requirements/Skillset:
 •    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.
 •    Must have 8 to 12 years’ experience.
 •    Must have IBM ACE, DataPower and IBM APIC analysis, design, coding, testing, debugging and performance tuning experience with strong ESQL, XSLT and Gateway Scripts.
 •    Experience with consuming and exposing protocols such as SOAP, REST, SAP IDocs and File Systems.
 •    Experience with data formats: XML, XML Schema, WSDL, DFDL, XSLT, JSON, IDOC etc.
 •    Experience with performance tuning of IBM ACE applications, IBM APIC and DataPower.
 •    Version Control tool experience, preferably GIT
 •    Experience with data transmission protocols: HTTP/S, TLS, MQ, and SAP adapters.
 •    Strong Database and SQL skills.
 •    WebSphere MQ application development skills. Understanding of MQ intercommunication architecture including queues and channels, MQ clustering, pub/sub from IBM ACE using MQ as the publication engine.
 •    Deep understanding of retail business and operations. 
 •    Experience in gathering business and technical requirements for new applications and application changes.
 •    Experience in creating detailed functional and technical design documents.
 •    Excellent problem-solving skills and teamwork orientation.
 •    Highly effective communication and collaboration skills.
 •    Ability to work within tight technical and business constraints.

Job Title: TIBCO Senior Developer

Level: Manager

Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai/Gurgaon/Pune




Job Summary:

As a Tibco Senior Developer- Manager, you will play a pivotal role in our Managed Services team, focusing on transitioning and running services, managing delivery teams, and optimizing processes to enhance client operations. Within our Managed Services practice, you will leverage your skills in project management, technology, and process optimization to deliver exceptional services that streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency for our clients.




As a Manager, you will enhance your leadership style by motivating, developing, and inspiring others to deliver quality. You will be responsible for coaching and leveraging team members' unique strengths to meet client expectations. With your growing business acumen, you will identify opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm, leading with integrity and authenticity while articulating our purpose and values meaningfully. You will embrace technology and innovation to enhance delivery and encourage others to do the same.




In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will address conflicts or issues, engage in challenging conversations with clients and team members, and uphold professional and technical standards, contributing to the firm's broader business strategies.




Responsibilities




- Leading the transition and management of outsourced services to optimize client operations

- Guiding delivery teams in continuous improvement and process optimization initiatives

- Managing project planning, budgeting, execution, and completion to meet client expectations

- Developing automation frameworks and solutions to enhance service delivery and operational efficiency

- Analyzing system components to identify interactions and improve performance

- Coaching team members to leverage their strengths and develop new skills

- Engaging in strategic questioning and stakeholder engagement to drive business transformation

- Implementing business process automation to streamline workflows and reduce costs

- Validating data quality automation processes to maintain service excellence

- Addressing conflicts and facilitating difficult conversations with clients and team members




Qualifications:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on integration solutions using TIBCO Business Works 5.x and above, TIBCO Business Events 5.x and above, TIBCO EMS, TIBCO HAWK.Experience in messaging solutions using TIBCO EMS, MQ , other JMS providers.Experience in TIBCO Data Virtualization.Experience/Strong Knowledge on Java , KAFKA streaming is preferable.Proven experience in developing and implementing RESTful/SOAP/Messaging services and other integration protocols.Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders.Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies is a plus.


Preferred Qualifications:

Professional TIBCO certification(s).TIBCO Business Works 5.x and above, TIBCO Business Events 5.x and above is mandatory.Experience/Knowledge with cloud platforms and services.Previous experience working in a globally distributed team environment.
